title: Clearances to combustible construction.
officialText:
Heat-producing equipment and appliances shall be installed to maintain the required
clearances to combustible construction as specified in the listing and manufacturer’s instructions. Such clearances shall be reduced
only in accordance with Section 308. Clearances to combustibles shall include such considerations as door swing, drawer pull,
overhead projections or shelving and window swing, shutters, coverings and drapes. Devices such as doorstops or limits, closers,
drapery ties or guards shall not be used to provide the required clearances.
